## Appropriate uses

Codespaces can help with repository editing, Quarto rendering, R/Bioconductor downstream analysis, and small command-line demonstrations.

## Limits

Do not promise full FASTQ-to-BAM execution. Storage, quotas, and runtime limits make large sequence processing unreliable for a teaching guarantee.

## Student instruction

Stop and delete unused codespaces to avoid quota exhaustion.
